en.title: One family, one system
en.focal: Kids' passports expire in 5 years, not 10
en.alt: Hand-drawn diagram of one family passport system: four passports (Dad, Mum, Kid 1, Kid 2) flowing into one encrypted vault, with expiry reminders, offline access and encrypted backup flowing out, and a note that kids' passports expire in 5 years not 10
en.caption: One family system: every passport in one place, with automated tracking for each expiry date
